incomplete_counties.about: counties where the US House's rows (by district, where the county has any) miss more than 2% of the precincts of the county's top contest (the most precincts with votes), holding more than 2% of its votes: [family, precincts missed, share of the top contest's votes]; with the chambers' precincts missed beside, not read since several states leave unopposed seats off the ballot or the file; a state that left a US House seat off the ballot (off_ballot_<year>, from data/house) is not read. Their district-level and local rows are missing (MEDSL's 2024 Monroe County: the Assembly's rows miss 185 of 655 precincts and the US House's 200, M2's seventh pass; the orchestrator, 22:19 item 1). Precincts missed are counted as the set difference but no more than the difference in counts, since a file can name one precinct apart in two contests, and their votes are the set difference's scaled by the ratio of the two [worker D3's reading]. whole_contests: the contests whose own rows are in the county's precincts (within 2%), so their district is the county and their rows are not missing in it: not held by the county [worker D3's reading]. missing_eg: up to eight of the precincts missed. 2020 untested: MEDSL's file holds local offices only

statewide_short.about: statewide contests (rows in 90% of the state's counties) whose rows miss more than 2% of a county's top contest's precincts, holding more than 2% of its votes: state -> office|district -> counties -> county -> [precincts missed, the county's precincts, share of the top contest's votes, those votes]; state_share: the votes missed against the state's (the counties' top contests summed). Held by local_medsl.coverage_gate where state_share is over 2% (the district is the state; 22:19 item 1: "any contest whose rows are missing in part of its district"), else kept with a note, unless the state's own count is read [worker D3's reading]

precinct_equivalences.about: by the year of MEDSL's file and state|county: [the name as a contest's rows give it, the top contest's name it is joined to], each 'jurisdiction / precinct'; a name in no row of the county's top contest joins the one top-contest name with the same jurisdiction code and the same numbers, where their words are equal or, both six letters or more, within two letters' edits or one's words among the other's, generic words aside (local_districts.precinct_equivalences)

spellings.about: MEDSL's lines of one contest spelled alike, their names sharing a surname and a given name or nickname: summed into one candidate's count where no precinct gives both lines votes, a row named as a total not counted a precinct (the orchestrator, 2026-11-13 04:44: "Sum the lines where their precincts are apart and the names share a surname and a given name, and list each pair. A name split by county is one candidate's count"); by year: lines [name, votes, precincts with votes, counties], summed, and why not where they are not (local_districts.merge_spellings)
